added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed run r-20261008T025419172961-flux-map-inventory declares no baseline_suite/after_suite pair (both manifest fields empty) and its run directory contains no pytest suite log, because the node's gate is a facility-side read-only inventory rather than a repo test run, so no added-failure count could be derived

findings.text: follow-on: the standalone check script re-implements a G EQDSK Fortran-float reader that partly duplicates imas_codex/cocos/loaders.py:113 load_from_eqdsk, but that loader exposes only psi_axis/psi_edge/ip/b0 for COCOS and returns no psi(R,Z) grid, so it cannot serve this grid-verification need; the duplication is justified by the script's stdlib-only constraint on the analysis host and warrants no change.

follow-on: the gate that reconciled the fragment tables against the JSON totals and per-code/per-owner counts (ROOTS=20 VALID=499 JT60SA=425 OTHER=74 in inventory-consistency.log) is an ad-hoc stdin script not committed, so a later edit that drops a file from the JSON or misstates a fragment count reddens nothing; the committed check_jt60sa_flux_maps.py verifies grids but not the inventory totals.

item_verdicts.call_sites: no production call sites: scripts/check_jt60sa_flux_maps.py is a standalone operator tool invoked as `ssh jt-60sa /usr/bin/python3.12 -`, adding no repo call site
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 7e9d77c617aafb4232f54ede439e946c55782394 (the parent of the first of five commits, c5980cc04) to head 5184f643132063072495ac7ca885496f907bc21b; the range adds 4 files, docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-discovery-completion/flux-map-inventory.html (84), .../flux-map-inventory.json (10859), docs/figures/jt60sa-flux-maps/selene-e101163-5s.svg (1061) and scripts/check_jt60sa_flux_maps.py (303), 12307 insertions, all inside the declared write paths.
item_verdicts.done_when: §45 done-when is met: the fragment gives per-code counts (CHEASE 2, LIUQE/MEQ 2, SA 282, SELENE 133, TOPICS 6) and per-owner counts (nine owners) with shot-range and time-slice columns, embeds the SELENE E101163 129x129 contour, states the unreachable central routes, and a committed check script re-reads EQ31, EQ11 and G EQDSK samples and verifies each grid at EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is §45: inventory every readable equilibrium in the 19 readable nakasvr26 homes plus /analysis_DB and render one; docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-discovery-completion/flux-map-inventory.html reports 499 validated grids (425 JT-60SA, 74 unrelated) as three tables plus an embedded SELENE figure, and the JSON beside it carries every path, owner, shot, time, grid and validation range.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records commits c5980cc..5184f643, changed_paths (four files), the check command and its EXIT=0 (five PASS, three formats), the consistency and two refusal controls, and declares no baseline_suite/after_suite, so no pytest added-failure count was derivable.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares five write entries; the four files landed (fragment html, fragment json, selene svg, check script) all lie inside docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-discovery-completion/, docs/figures/jt60sa-flux-maps/ and scripts/, and the fifth declared figures directory was left unused without consequence.

justifications.durability: scripts/check_jt60sa_flux_maps.py is committed and re-runnable, so the grid re-read is durable, but it depends on facility-side data reachable only from the analysis host and is not wired into the repo suite or CI, and the inventory-consistency reconciler that ties the JSON totals to the fragment was an uncommitted stdin script, so an edit that desyncs counts fails nothing.
justifications.evidence: each gate log's first line names revision=5184f643132063072495ac7ca885496f907bc21b, its tree, and the literal command, and ends EXIT=0 (flux-grid-check.log five PASS across all three formats; inventory-consistency.log ROOTS=20 VALID=499 JT60SA=425 FORMAT_COUNTS) with the two refusal controls at EXIT=1 (out-of-scope root, non-grid file); I independently re-read the JSON and confirmed 499 files, 425 with a non-null facility_basis, 74 null, and codes SA 282/SELENE 133/TOPICS 6/CHEASE 2/LIUQE-MEQ 2 matching the fragment tables, but the flux-grid-check piped the script via stdin so no digest binds that stdin to the committed file.
justifications.fit: the fragment follows the id-anchored section-and-pre idiom of sibling docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-discovery-completion/*.html, its ids (flux-map-inventory-*) carry no plan label or version, the JSON sits beside the fragment, and the SVG lands under docs/figures/jt60sa-flux-maps/ at 1008pt (14in) width, matching the repository data-ink size rule.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-discovery-completion/flux-map-inventory.html gives the per-code and per-owner tables with shot ranges and time slices, embeds the SELENE E101163 5.000s contour (129x129, psi -0.5500..1.3938), and states the unreachable central routes (dbsvr17p unresolved; /JT60SA_EQ/EQDB, EQDB_EFIT and the /analysis_DB EQDB paths absent), matching §45's done-when line for line.
justifications.reuse: the diff adds one standalone script that cannot import imas_codex on the analysis host; its G EQDSK reader partly overlaps imas_codex/cocos/loaders.py load_from_eqdsk, which returns no psi(R,Z) grid and so cannot serve grid verification, and its SELENE EQ31/EQ11 binary readers have no existing owner in the repo, so no capability was forked.
justifications.scope_discipline: all four files added by the five commits — the fragment html and json, the selene svg and the check script — lie inside the manifest's declared write paths, and no file outside them was touched.
